svg.text: A stale reference comes with a proposed range
Diff arithmetic only: the tool says where to look and proposes; the author judges whether the explanation still holds.

g.text: ProposeRange: start and end through the hunks
Unchanged boundary line: shifts by the hunks before it.
Boundary line a hunk changed: maps to that hunk's
edge on the new side. Lines inserted inside are taken
in; widened whenever it takes in lines the range lacked.
Refuses: every line removed, a rewrite that leaves no
original line and crosses the edge, or only braces,
blank or punctuation lines left to anchor it.
L220-L257 -> L238-L280 (widened: +5 lines inside)
Resolver.Propose: the proposal and its diff
Location at the view, widened flag, reason, and the
zero-context -old/+new diff inside the range (capped),
between the nearest hunk just before and just after it,
so an extracted helper or a move shows beside it.
Nothing proposed: deleted file (content may have moved),
binary, unreadable pin, or a mismatched digest.
A whole-file reference proposes the same file, after
any rename, at the view.
Shown where agents already look
references --stale prints "proposed: old -> new", the diff, and "accept after reading: change-saga repin --accept-proposed ...";
its JSON gains proposal and accept on each stale reference. reconcile, status, review list and refresh-coverage reuse it.

proposed: internal/reviewstore/reviewstore.go#L220-L257 -> internal/reviewstore/reviewstore.go#L238-L280
